# IMPERIA COLD WAR — South Vietnam 1970 on_actions
# IMPERIA COLD WAR update 20.11.2026: performance pass after the quaZa import: no daily ticks; weekly TAG pass, government changes, wars, peace conferences and sanctions instead.
## Generated by svn_build.py (COLDWAR_SVN generator, stages B1-B2) from the approved design of 12.11.2026. Edit the generator or the design, not this file.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { SVN = { exists = yes } } SVN = { COLDWAR_SVN_initialize = yes } }
		}
	}
	on_monthly_SVN = {
		effect = {
			COLDWAR_SVN_monthly = yes
		}
	}
	on_new_term_election = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = SVN has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_third_ballot_flag }
				set_temp_variable = { party_index = 18 }
				set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.03 }
				set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.03 }
				change_relative_party_popularity = yes
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SVN_third_ballot_flag
			}
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { original_tag = SVN } COLDWAR_SVN_sync_politics = yes }
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { original_tag = SVN } COLDWAR_SVN_sync_politics = yes }
		}
	}
}
